note.zh-TW: 課程的企業績效指標以 Profit 代表；計算器統一期間並標示是否年化。英文別名 net income 是美式用語。
note.en: The course’s business performance indicators use Profit for it; the calculator aligns the periods and says whether figures are annualised. The alias net income is American usage.

definition.zh-TW: 五層利益的最後一層：稅前淨利減掉所得稅費用後的金額，是這一期經營成果的總結，屬於股東。期末結帳時它併入未分配盈餘，成為資產負債表股東權益的一部分，損益表與資產負債表在這裡接上。
definition.en: The last of the five profit levels: profit before tax less income tax expense, summing up what the period’s operations achieved for the shareholders. At the period-end close it is transferred into unappropriated retained earnings and becomes part of equity on the balance sheet, which is where the income statement and the balance sheet connect.
